10: 60 ml | vegetable oil, for the tin | Pantry
11: None  | salt and pepper, to taste | Pantry
steps: 0: (20 min) Make the batter by whisking the flour, 4 eggs and milk and rest it. Fry the chopped mushrooms and onion in the 2 tbsp oil until dry and dark, then season.
1: (15 min) Sear the portobellos, then lay them in a line on the pastry with the mushroom mix, roll up and brush with the last egg, beaten.
2: (40 min) Bake at 200C until the pastry is deep golden.
3: (10 min) Heat the oil for the tin in a muffin tin at 230C.
4: (20 min) Pour the batter into the hot tin and bake until puffed and golden.
5: (5 min) Make gravy by boiling the stock with the soy sauce and any mushroom juices, then slice the Wellington.
veg.name: Erebor mushroom Wellington and Yorkshire puddings

steps: 0: (3 min) Peel three strips of zest from the orange and slice the rest of it thinly.
1: (15 min) Simmer the apple juice with the cinnamon, cloves, star anise, zest and sugar over low heat, without boiling hard.
2: (3 min) Strain into mugs and add a fresh cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each.
